edits.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand / precise-object-edit.
Edit the supplied original black-and-white astrum-scena logo. Treat the supplied image as the edit target, not just loose inspiration.
Keep the original stage-frame geometry, perspective-shaped base, side panels, overall proportions, pure white background, black-and-white palette, and generous surrounding whitespace.
Make these specific changes only:
1. Close the large gap at the top completely. Reconstruct a single continuous black upper horizontal beam, with a clean straight upper edge and coherent lower edge, joining the left and right sides. There must be no arbitrary gap in the top beam.
2. Enlarge the existing four-point star by approximately 1.8 to 2 times. Keep its recognizable concave curved four-point silhouette, but give it a fuller central body so it reads as a star at small sizes rather than a thin plus sign.
3. Raise the star so its upper ray passes through the top beam and visibly extends above its outer top edge. The star center and horizontal rays should remain just BELOW the lower edge of the upper beam, in the white stage interior. Keep the star slightly right of horizontal center as in the original.
4. Apply precise color inversion ONLY where the star overlaps the black beam: the star is BLACK over the white background and stage interior, and WHITE inside the black upper beam. The star outline must remain one coherent continuous silhouette through all color changes. This is a flat boolean/XOR figure-ground effect, no outlines, no white halo, no drop shadows.
Keep the bottom and sides of the original frame unchanged. No extra star, no decoration, no text or wordmark, no new colors, no mockup. Flat crisp vector-like logo study. One mark only.
